hypotheses.statement: Relative object scale vs stride dominates small-object AP: train-on-small beats train-on-large when val is small-only.
hypotheses.interpretation: Matched scale training improves small-object detection under fixed stride.

hypotheses.statement: Under pure localization noise, COCO AP (0.5:0.95) drops at least as much as AP50 and is more sensitive.
hypotheses.interpretation: High-IoU thresholds punish localization error — protocol choice changes conclusions.

hypotheses.statement: Including classification cost in Hungarian improves GT-class probability consistency of matches.
hypotheses.interpretation: Class term in matching cost matters — DETR design choice is not pure box matching.
